# Mesa Wren Landscape Co.

> Official AI-readable overview for Mesa Wren Landscape Co., a residential landscape design-build company serving Scottsdale, Phoenix, and nearby Arizona communities.

## What The Company Does
- Residential landscape design and build
- Hardscaping, patios, pavers, and retaining walls
- Outdoor kitchens, fire features, and outdoor lighting
- Desert-friendly landscaping, artificial turf, and irrigation upgrades

## Who It Serves
- Homeowners in Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Phoenix, Fountain Hills, Cave Creek, Gilbert, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Glendale, Peoria, Ahwatukee, North Phoenix
- Best fit for premium outdoor living upgrades, full-yard planning, and phased design-build projects
